meta.name: Onigiri
meta.description: Onigiri thrusts its players into mystical Japan, a land filled with mythical creatures of Japanese legend. Starting as a lone Oni, players fight against the malevolent influence of the Kamikui as their miasma spreads over the land. 8 NPCs, each with their own distinct personality and skills, ally themselves with the player to help build a legend, and quell the evil that has arisen. As you grow stronger together, so do the bonds binding you to each other.

videos.title: The Curtain Raises on Onigiri
videos.overview: This is the story the girls who fight the evil Kamigui... or is it? The adventure begins when Shizuka Gozen and Yoshitsune are separated from the others after a fierce battle!

videos.title: Pandora's Box
videos.overview: Shizuka and Yoshitsune approach the village of Chikuhou where they meet the high spirited Ibaraki-Doji.

videos.title: Burning Hakata
videos.overview: Amaterasu finds herself fighting against a kamikui that may be too big for her to handle! Meanwhile, Yoshitsune and Shizuka Gozen enjoy Hakata ramen?

videos.title: Leap in the Darkness
videos.overview: The girls recover while three mysterious figures lie in wait to target Shizuka Gozen. However, they won't be mysterious for very long.

videos.title: Marital Vows
videos.overview: As they stand against the Kamikui, Jin and Sakura remember their whirlwind romance.

videos.title: Lottery First Prize
videos.overview: The girls trek to a convenience store, only to discover that Kaguya is obsessed with a particular game of chance.

videos.title: Dreaming a Life Away
videos.overview: The girls are close to finding the kamikui that defeated them, but they get a little sidetracked.

videos.title: A Transient Dream
videos.overview: Shizuka Gozen, Yoshistune, Amaterasu and the others have suddenly gone chibi, but this little problem might be a big opportunity as they get scouted to become idols.

videos.title: The Pain of Separation
videos.overview: Not all kamikui are angry god eaters. Some, namely the sisters Gako and Gagomi, rather prefer udon! However, kamikui killers arrive on scene and tear the two apart.

videos.title: Illusions of Dreams
videos.overview: Despite Gako's amnesia, Shizuka Gozen immediately befriends her, but what happens when Gako's buried memories begin to stir?

videos.title: Battle of the Strongest
videos.overview: Shizuka Gozen pleads with Gako to end their fight, but Gako refuses to back down. However, something much bigger and more dangerous looms overhead.

videos.title: What If World!!
videos.overview: With the giant kamikui attacking, the girls have no choice but to fight with all they have! Can the humanoid armor Benkei help them save the world?

videos.title: Onigiri Final
videos.overview: The girls are called forward to take responsibility for going overboard, only for the kamikui to revive even stronger!
